ads_first_offer_body: Rewarded ads are optional. Watching one grants the reward shown; skipping it never blocks progress, and you can keep playing or buy upgrades with Aura.
analytics_body: Share limited gameplay and technical events from now on. Your save, exact Aura values, name, age, and account are not collected.
analytics_details_body: Collection starts only if you allow it. Earlier actions are not sent. You can turn it off later in Settings. Data is kept for two months and is not exported to another data warehouse.
analytics_setting_off: Analytics are off on this device.
analytics_setting_on: Future eligible events may be sent from this device.
ascension_confirm_body: This restarts the listed economy and permanently updates your multiplier to {multiplier}.
ascension_keeps_body: Total Aura, tiers, Transformations, Achievements, 67 Seals, Appearances, and your permanent Ascension multiplier.
ascension_locked: Produce {amount} more Journey Aura to Ascend.
ascension_pending_return: Finish the pending return choice before Ascending. The base reward is already safe.
ascension_resets_body: Available Aura, Journey Aura, Technique levels, Aura Item levels, and their current production.
backup_explain: Export your progress to a file you control. This game does not sync or recover saves automatically.
backup_export_failed: Backup could not be exported. Your current progress is unchanged.
backup_export_success: Backup exported. Keep the file somewhere safe.
backup_invalid: This file is not a valid supported backup. Your current progress is unchanged.
backup_replace_warning: Restoring replaces the progress currently on this device. This cannot be undone.
backup_restore_failed: The backup could not be restored. Your previous progress is still active.
backup_too_new: This backup was made by a newer game version and cannot be restored here.
collection_effect_persists: Item effects stay active with any appearance.
content.ach_s_01.description: Six waited 67 seconds. Seven still answered.
content.ach_s_01.name: Held the Pose
content.ach_s_02.description: You came back after 6 hours and 7 minutes.
content.ach_s_02.name: Quiet Hours
content.ach_s_03.description: You left exactly 67 Aura on the table.
content.ach_s_03.name: Exact Balance
content.ach_s_04.description: One credit crossed more than one 67 milestone.
content.ach_s_04.name: Signals Stacked
content.ach_s_05.name: Routes Agree
content.ach_s_06.description: Every Convergence is active in one journey.
content.ach_s_06.name: Full Spectrum
content.ach_s_07.description: You completed a second Aura Ascension.
content.ach_s_07.name: Again, With Feeling
content.ach_v_01.description: You completed your first Six-Seven Cycle.
content.ach_v_01.name: First Shift
content.ach_v_02.name: Hands in Motion
content.ach_v_03.description: Your first Aura Item started producing.
content.ach_v_03.name: Passive Presence
content.ach_v_04.description: You put one level into every root route.
content.ach_v_04.name: Three Directions
content.ach_v_05.name: The Room Noticed
content.ach_v_06.description: You completed your first Aura Ascension.
content.ach_v_06.name: Same Presence, Bigger Sky
content.branch_a.description: Quiet presence, clean lines, and visual weight.
content.branch_a.name: Poise
content.branch_b.description: Pulse, movement, and echoes that wake the scene.
content.branch_b.name: Motion
content.branch_c.description: Loops, static, and a horizon that keeps expanding.
content.branch_c.name: Signal
content.form_01.description: A clear outline turns the first spark into a steady glow.
content.form_01.name: First Glow
content.form_02.description: Your presence arrives twice, one clean echo behind.
content.form_02.name: Afterimage
content.form_03.description: The whole scene starts carrying your signal.
content.form_03.name: Neon Weather
content.form_04.description: One pulse reaches from the mascot to the horizon.
content.form_04.name: Skyline Pulse
content.form_05.description: Every route of Aura meets at the highest point.
content.form_05.name: Aura Zenith
content.item_a_01.description: On Six, it looks decorative. On Seven, too — but now it produces Aura.
content.item_a_01.name: Suspicious Button
content.item_a_02.description: Proves you spent everything. Regret comes without a receipt.
content.item_a_02.name: Glow Receipt
content.item_a_03.description: Reveal three bugs. Two will be promoted to mechanics.
content.item_a_03.name: QA Goggles
content.item_a_04.description: The zipper opens only when the previous pocket reaches level 50.
content.item_a_04.name: Gate Coat
content.item_a_05.description: Installed at 5:59 PM. Since then, the universe avoids eye contact.
content.item_a_05.name: Hotfix Crown
content.item_b_01.description: Rings one minute after impossible. You were already late for your own Aura.
content.item_b_01.name: 6:70 Alarm Clock
content.item_b_02.description: Arrive two cycles late and demand retroactive Aura.
content.item_b_02.name: Lag Shoes
content.item_b_03.description: Holds 0.9999999 Aura and a tax grievance too small to abbreviate.
content.item_b_03.name: Remainder Ring
content.item_b_04.description: Six works. Seven appears in the delivery photo.
content.item_b_04.name: Two-Tap Union
content.item_b_05.description: Available Aura plummets. Total Aura calls it growth.
content.item_b_05.name: Creative Astral Statement
content.item_c_01.description: It was a bug until someone wrote “expected behavior.”
content.item_c_01.name: Certified Glitch
content.item_c_02.description: The interface cannot see it. The economy knows where it lives.
content.item_c_02.name: Fugitive Decimal
content.item_c_03.description: It was equipped yesterday. The interface preferred to mention it today.
content.item_c_03.name: Cache Cape
content.item_c_04.description: The game works offline. It blinks to keep up appearances.
content.item_c_04.name: Unemployed Router
content.item_c_05.description: The horizon was not found. We framed the error and moved on.
content.item_c_05.name: 404 Frame
content.item_conv_01.description: Three routes arrived. Now everyone pretends to be aligned.
content.item_conv_01.name: Meeting Knot
content.item_conv_02.description: The three branches stopped arguing and called it Spectrum.
content.item_conv_02.name: Convergence by Exhaustion
content.item_conv_03.description: Nobody knows where it fits. Removing it deletes half the universe.
content.item_conv_03.name: Canonical Screw
content.signal_67.name: Signal 67
content.tech_01.description: Set one hand. Send the other.
content.tech_01.name: Switch Stance
content.tech_02.description: One side rises as the other answers.
content.tech_02.name: Counterflow
content.tech_03.description: The next move leaves an echo behind.
content.tech_03.name: Ghost Timing
content.tech_04.description: The motion lands twice. The reward lands once.
content.tech_04.name: Double Take
content.tech_05.name: Zero-Drag
content.tech_06.description: Six moves. Seven closes the signal.
content.tech_06.name: Perfect Shift
diagnostic_body: The game saved {count, plural, one {# technical report} other {# technical reports}} after the last problem. Send only this pending batch to help diagnose it?
diagnostic_details_body: Reports may include the error trace, app version, device details, time, and an installation identifier. They never include your save, exact Aura values, or age signals. If analytics was already on, approved event breadcrumbs may be included.
diagnostic_queued: Report queued. It will send when a connection is available.

store_feature_graphic_alt: Mascot switching oversized hands between Six and Seven as Aura fills the scene.
store_full_description:
Tap twice to complete a Six-Seven Cycle and farm Aura. Build active Techniques, grow three equally strong Aura Tree paths, collect Appearances, unlock Transformations, and Ascend for permanent momentum.

Play your way:
• Active and passive progress
• Up to 4 hours of Offline Production
• Optional rewarded ads only
• No account, required connection, or in-app purchases
• Manual Backup, accessibility controls, and 8 languages

Aura Shift: Six Seven is a trend-driven incremental game for ages 13 and up.
store_short_description: Two taps. Infinite Aura. Build your style and shift the whole scene.

system_external_link_failed: The page could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.
system_generic_error: Something went wrong. Your progress is safe.
system_save_failed: Progress could not be saved. Keep the game open and try again.

tutorial_second_touch: One more tap. Complete the Six-Seven.
